answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity's attestation is sealed in a cryptographic vault, opened only by a fresh proof bound to the current epoch. A saffron strand of provenance traces every contribution back to its origin, blocking replay. The system emits a signal when correlated patterns appear - matching timestamps or shared infrastructure - flagging the cluster for audit. Clones cannot open their vaults without genuine epoch-bound work; each fake proof must survive signal detection. Cost compounds per clone while reward stays flat.
